title: Tunnels of Doom stairs-descend: the executable behavioral model (R4)
summary: Appended package. It adds the R4 executable model, static control-flow facts from the byte-verified owner-local GSL decode, three previously unnamed operations (>66E5, >66B3, >8018), the frozen experiment matrix, and the accepted model-versus-authentic comparison. The additional held-out >1CE8=00 case followed the predicted >66B3 bypass without reading >10FE and reproduced the accepted mutations, delayed copy, and DESCENDING effect deterministically. It rewrites nothing in the accepted R1-R3 packages.
seeded_from: docs/TOD-STAIRS-MODEL.md and the byte-verified owner-local GSL decode of the matching cartridge bytes at >669B..>66E5 and >A798

evidence.detail: R4 model specification: boundary, neutral data layout, exact pseudocode, interpreter metadata, declared matrix, comparison file format, and retained uncertainty
the executable model itself, with its predict/compare commands; tools/test_tod_stairs_model.py is its focused suite
byte-verified owner-local GSL decode of the matching cartridge bytes at >669B..>66E5 and >A798; referenced logically — no bytes, listing, decompilation, or path is stored here
two fresh authentic runs from the accepted spawn checkpoint with only >1CE8 changed to 00 before FCTN+X; compact filtered captures remain owner-local

versioned comparison of the frozen model against accepted positive, accepted negative, and new held-out observations: 22 of 22 declared in-boundary fields matched; no case data or artifact path is tracked

entities.name: executable behavioral model of the stairs-descend decision
entities.detail: tools/tod_stairs_model.py: predicts the GPL decision at >669B, the immediate mutations at >66C7/>66CB, the separately applied delayed copy at >A798, and the DESCENDING classification. It is a reconstruction, not an emulator or GPL runtime; the callees, renderer, map, party, combat, and timing are outside it.

entities.name: held-out secondary-flag bypass experiment
entities.detail: fresh spawn checkpoint; before input only VRAM >1CE8 is set from 01 to 00, then `hold fctn x`; run twice from fresh probe processes and required to produce identical filtered evidence and in-boundary results

entities.name: GPL secondary-flag bypass branch to the accepted target
GPL external-condition subroutine called on the fallback path
entities.detail: reached only when unsigned >10FE < >1CF8, after message >2D; the callee's predicate is not recovered

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-669B
facts.value: a key byte other than 0A leaves the routine at >66E5

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66A0
facts.value: accepts 04 and skips the second comparison; every other value falls through to >66A7

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66A7
facts.value: requires 06; any other value reaches the branch bytes at >66AC and continues at >663F

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66AE
facts.value: compares >1CE8 with 01; a value other than 01 takes the >66B3 bypass to >66C7 without reading >10FE

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66B5
facts.value: unsigned >10FE >= >1CF8 continues to >66C7; the lower case issues message >2D and calls >8018
facts.note: unsigned: >80 against >7F continues, where a signed reading would take the fallback

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66C7
facts.value: >1CF8 increments within a byte; >FF wraps to >00

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66CB
facts.value: stores the immediate byte 05 into >1D00

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-A798
facts.value: copies >1CF8 into >10FA

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66E5
facts.value: the continuation target of the input rejection at >669B; no in-boundary state is written on that path

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-66B3
facts.value: the branch that reaches the accepted target >66C7 when >1CE8 is not 01

facts.subject: tod.op.gpl-8018
facts.value: called after message >2D when unsigned >10FE < >1CF8

facts.value: six range-checked 0..255 bytes named key_code, vram_1d00, vram_1ce8, vram_10fe, vram_1cf8, and vram_10fa, plus the explicit optional continuation_allowed

facts.subject: tod.model.stairs-descend

facts.subject: tod.model.stairs-descend
